From browsing to the start line

Five ways in: open, lottery, time qualifier, charity, or membership. Each race says which.

  1. Find a raceFilter by distance, terrain, borough and status.
  2. See how to enterEntry method and deadlines for this year’s edition.
  3. Save itInterested, Considering or Signed up.
  4. Add the datesRace day and registration, with calendar alerts.
  5. RegisterOn the organizer’s official page.
Every date links to its official source and shows when it was last checked. Unannounced dates are marked, never guessed.Not affiliated with any race organizer.
